new_results.statement: For a shifted square a(X-b)^2 with density cap M, E|a[(X-b)^2-(X'-b)^2]|^{-1/2} <= [16 sqrt(2)/3^(3/4)] M |a|^{-1/2}.

Any nonzero original physical diagonal a lifts the translation-uniform square collision energies through an arbitrary ambient residual by conditional Jensen; for every 0<alpha<1, int |t|^(alpha-1)|phi_Q(t)|^2 is universally bounded by the square constant times |a|^{-alpha}.
Combining the pivot theorem with account03/B03 r18 gives E|Q-Q'|^{-1/2} <= min(C_*|A_ii|^{-1/2}, [8r/(2r-1)] Delta_r^{-1/(2r)}).

Critical |phi|=O(|t|^{-1/2}) plus every subcritical weighted L2 collision energy does not imply a finite one-copy half-Riesz potential; Y=X^2 for X uniform[-1/2,1/2] is an actual cap-one characteristic-function witness.

first_unpaid_implication: In the genuine rank-one/star survivor, retain original-coordinate product geometry strongly enough to average the random linear coefficient as in account03/B03, or expose a second effective cross direction/independent smoothing packet before absolute values. Generic Holder interpolation of the pivot and rank-one collision certificates is ruled out.
